name: hms_sdk
_comment: Huawei Mobile Services support, built like desktop_sdk: an SDK module, NOT productFlavors. Dart-side it owns DeviceServices ({gms, hms, neither} detection, cached, fail-open to gms) and HmsPushBootstrap (Push Kit token acquisition + backend sync through the same api.user.register_device_token gateway cmd the FCM token uses, with provider 'hms'). No installs: unlike desktop_sdk this ships no per-platform template tree - the Android template's BUILD_HMS-gated AGConnect wiring lives statically in core/base/dart/templates/android (the installer has no Gradle marker injection; only AndroidManifest.xml permissions and iOS plist keys are injectable). No extra Android permissions either: push needs POST_NOTIFICATIONS/VIBRATE, which comms_sdk (the push owner) already injects into the @sdk-android-permissions marker block.

boot_hooks._comment: Order 30: after comms' Firebase/FCM boot (10) and its desktop notification poller (20) - order 20 is already taken and duplicate orders draw a composer warning. Android-only and fail-open like comms' hooks. The initialize() call itself is a strict no-op unless DeviceServices proves the device GMS-free AND HMS-capable, so GMS devices and detection errors keep comms_sdk's FCM path as the sole push owner. The await is cheap: initialize() only awaits the availability probe and turnOnPush - the push token arrives asynchronously on Push Kit's token stream, so runApp is never delayed by a token round-trip.
